    Unit mesh coefficients #

    Lemma 4.4 (lem:unit-mesh-coefficients, scalar-normalization.tex): "Regard its coefficients as a multiplicative cellular two-cochain on K, assigning c_{X,a} to the triangle with boundary (σa) a t_X⁻¹. […] Rescale the path arrow a by φ(a) and divide the whole mesh relation at X by φ(t_X). These operations change its coefficient to c_{X,a}(dφ)(X,a) […] There are no 3-cells, and Lemma 4.2 makes K homotopy equivalent to a graph. Thus its cellular H²(K;k^*) is zero, so every two-cochain is a coboundary."

    Here H²(K; G) = 0 for an abelian group G is proved from the acyclic matching of Lemma 4.2 (Morse.exists_cochain): the matched edge of each triangle is solved for, in increasing order of the potential. For the mesh complex this gives the rescaling (exists_unit_rescaling).
